intents.name: playback_error
intents.definition: Customer cannot play on-demand/VOD content due to errors, buffering, spinning wheel, freezing, black screen, or stream failing to start (not specifically Live TV sports/channels).
in_scope_examples: I keep getting playback errors on Roku
error 0320 when I try to play a show
out_of_scope_examples: Live TV football channel won't load

intents.name: live_tv_issues
intents.definition: Problems with Hulu Live TV / live channels / live sports streams (channel missing, live stream glitching, game not playing).
in_scope_examples: Sunday night football channel didn't work
Live TV on Roku not loading local CBS
out_of_scope_examples: I want a refund for Live TV

intents.name: app_device_issue
intents.definition: App/device platform problems: crashes, install/update issues, Roku/Fire TV/Smart TV quirks, audio sync, profile UI on a device.
in_scope_examples: Hulu app on Samsung TV won't show profiles
Sound doesn't match video on Fire Stick

intents.name: login_account
intents.definition: Login, sign-in, password, account access, email/username, or account/profile access barriers (not billing plan selection alone).
in_scope_examples: Can't log into my account
Password reset not working
out_of_scope_examples: Fire Stick asks me to choose a plan

intents.name: billing_subscription
intents.definition: Charges, refunds, cancellations, plan price, free trial, commercials/ad-tier complaints tied to what the customer pays for.
in_scope_examples: Paying $40/mo but still forced to watch ads
How do I cancel / get my money back
out_of_scope_examples: Ads are annoying but no billing ask

intents.name: content_availability
intents.definition: Missing/removed shows, seasons, episodes; requests for when content will be added or why it disappeared.
in_scope_examples: When are you adding season 3 of Rick & Morty?
Gold Rush episodes aren't uploading

intents.name: service_outage
intents.definition: Reports that Hulu is down / widespread outage / 'anyone else' service failure without a specific device-only bug.
in_scope_examples: Anyone else having major issues with Hulu right now?
Is Hulu down?

intents.name: how_to_feature
intents.definition: Informational how-to / feature questions (profiles, settings, Alexa, downloads) without an active outage/error incident.
in_scope_examples: How do I create a profile?
Is there an Alexa skill for Hulu?
out_of_scope_examples: How do I get a refund?

intents.name: feedback_complaint
intents.definition: General dissatisfaction, rant, or cancellation threat without a concrete troubleshooting/billing/content request.
in_scope_examples: Ready to cancel, Hulu is the worst
Huge mistake subscribing, everything is glitchy (no ask)

intents.name: other_ambiguous
intents.definition: Unclear, multi-intent without a dominant ask, too short to classify, or not covered by the above intents.
in_scope_examples: @hulu_support help
@hulu_support ???
intents.notes: Use sparingly; prefer a primary intent when one clearly dominates.

notes: Derived from train-only exploration of real hulu_support messages.
Cluster names from KMeans were used only as hints, then rewritten.
